slides.title: Vinted told HMRC about your sales?
slides.sub: Being reported is not the same as owing tax. Here is the difference.

slides.title: Who gets reported
body: Selling sites now report sellers to HMRC.
You are not reported if you make fewer than 30 sales of goods in a calendar year.
And get less than about £1,700 (2,000 euros) for them.

slides.title: Reported does not mean you owe
body: HMRC says a report does not automatically mean tax is due.
Clearing out your loft or wardrobe?
You are unlikely to pay tax on personal items.

slides.title: When it becomes trading
body: Buying or making things to sell for a profit is likely trading.
Total sales up to £1,000 a year are covered by the trading allowance.
Over £1,000 and you need to register for Self Assessment.

slides.title: Not sure which side you're on?
body: Ask Hustle Mate and get a plain-English answer.
